Ethionamide has also been used as rectal suppositories; the hy- drochloride has been given intravenously. Administration in children. For the treatment of drug-resist- ant tuberculosis in infants, children, and adolescents the Ameri- can Academy of Pediatrics suggests an oral dose of ethionamide 15 to 20 mg/kg (to a maximum of 1 g) daily, given in 2 to 3 di- vided doses.
